name: HubSpot
summary: HubSpot is an inbound platform for CRM, marketing automation, and analytics, supporting OAuth2 authentication. Apps intended for multiple HubSpot accounts or for listing in the marketplace must use OAuth. Both Composio-managed OAuth and bring-your-own-app OAuth setups are supported, with managed OAuth offered for fastest onboarding but with scope and branding limits.
decision: If the default Composio-managed OAuth app's permissions and warning status are acceptable for your use case, you can use Composio-managed auth for the fastest setup. If you need custom scopes, custom branding, or want to avoid 'Connecting an unverified app' warnings, create your own HubSpot developer app and configure OAuth following HubSpot's official guide.

prerequisites.title: Create a HubSpot Developer Account
prerequisites.body: You'll need a developer account to create and manage OAuth apps.

prerequisites.title: Create or Identify the App you wish to connect
prerequisites.body: If bringing your own app, create a new public app in your HubSpot developer dashboard. If using managed auth, no app creation is necessary, but scope limits apply.

prerequisites.title: Have a HubSpot Account to authorize into
prerequisites.body: You need a HubSpot account (production or test) where the app will be installed.

prerequisites.title: Super Admin Permissions
prerequisites.body: The user installing the app must be a Super Admin or have Marketplace Access permissions.

steps.title: Choose Composio-managed OAuth or bring-your-own app
steps.body: If your permissions needs and branding are covered by the Composio-managed app, you can proceed with managed OAuth via the Composio UI. Otherwise, proceed to create your own public OAuth app on the HubSpot developer portal.

steps.title: Configure Required and Optional Scopes
steps.body: In the HubSpot developer app, mark required and optional scopes as needed. Ensure the scopes match between Composio and your HubSpot app. For managed OAuth, you may only remove optional scopes; you cannot add new ones.

steps.title: Set Redirect URI
steps.body: Set the redirect URI (https required in production) in your HubSpot app settings; must match the value used in authorization URLs and Composio config.

steps.title: Direct User to Authorization URL
steps.body: Build an authorization URL using your app's client_id, required scopes, and redirect_uri. Send the user to this URL. For managed OAuth, Composio generates this; for custom apps, build and serve the URL in your integration.

steps.title: Authorize App and Handle User Consent
steps.body: User reviews the requested permissions in the browser and grants authorization to your app.

steps.title: Process OAuth Redirect
steps.body: User will be redirected back to the specified redirect_uri with a code in the query string if access is granted or with error parameters if not.

steps.title: Exchange Code for Tokens
steps.body: Use the authorization code with the client_id, client_secret, grant_type=authorization_code, and redirect_uri to request access_token and refresh_token from HubSpot's token endpoint.

steps.title: Store Tokens
steps.body: Securely store the access_token and refresh_token for making authenticated API calls.

steps.title: Renew Access Token as Needed
steps.body: When the access_token expires, use the refresh_token to obtain a new one.

steps.title: Test Your Integration
steps.body: Verify that the integration can authenticate and access the requested HubSpot APIs according to your selected scopes.

blockers.title: Unverified App Warning
blockers.body: If using Composio-managed OAuth, your users may see a 'Connecting an unverified app' warning until the app is fully reviewed and approved by HubSpot.

blockers.title: Scope Mismatch
blockers.body: If the scopes requested do not match between the Composio config and the HubSpot app, or aren't enabled in the app, authentication will fail.

blockers.title: Insufficient User Permissions
blockers.body: Only Super Admins or users with Marketplace Access permissions can install apps.

human_actions.title: Create and configure a HubSpot developer app (if using own app)
human_actions.body: Log in to HubSpot developer portal, create an app, configure scopes, and set the redirect URI.

human_actions.title: Enter/connect credentials in Composio (for managed auth, as needed)
human_actions.body: Use the Composio connection UI to initiate OAuth consent using managed credentials, or enter your app credentials if using a custom app setup.

human_actions.title: Grant consent in user’s HubSpot account
human_actions.body: When prompted during OAuth, the user must review requested permissions and accept to complete the authorization.
